initial:
Use case: style-transfer / ui-mockup. Transform the supplied Glass Tide art-direction board into ONE single full-screen believable in-game visual mockup for its existing 2D top-down Canvas survival arena. This is camera comparison A. Keep the exact art direction and organism designs of the reference, but replace its cinematic angle and specimen-board layout completely.

CAMERA IS THE PRIMARY REQUIREMENT: PERFECTLY VERTICAL 90-DEGREE OVERHEAD ORTHOGRAPHIC, camera pointing straight down perpendicular to the ground, like a detailed painted top-down action game. Absolutely NO horizon, sky, vanishing point, isometric diamond, oblique perspective, visible upright full-body character portraits, foreground trees framing a distant landscape, or angled postcard scene. We see the TOPS of helmets, shoulders, seed-pod shells, plant crowns and wreckage. Ground circles are circles, not ellipses. The arena's south boundary runs perfectly horizontally. Flat screen-aligned X/Y world, equal scale in all directions. Make it obvious that this art could be sprites layered into a 2D Canvas renderer.

Composition: landscape 16:9 image, full-screen continuous game view, no specimen panels. We see a LOCAL area of a larger square arena, with one south entry opening at bottom-center between two low pale shell/root boundary sections, quiet exterior staging ground below it. A short soft line of tiny text by opening reads 'SOUTH PASSAGE'. Central human player has an ochre ceramic hood seen from ABOVE, dark kelp-fiber split mantle, compact shoulder pack and clear small pale identification outline; its total footprint around 32 pixels on a 1536px-wide image, not a giant hero. A second small human farther upper-left. Six or seven SMALL translucent seed-pod/chitin hunters, roughly player-sized, orange nuclei, petal fins and short shadows; two folded harmless pearl eggs. One sentinel to the player's upper-right, one farther right, two above, one near left. No giant enemies. Keep organisms large enough for silhouette recognition at actual gameplay scale.

GROUND: Glass Tide's pearl/celadon silt under a thin transparent sheet of shallow teal water, restrained ripples, mottled sparse lavender ground plants, continuous traversable surface. Seven discrete circular rooted obstacle mounds, each 3-5 times a player's width, topped by translucent bladder rosettes, coral reeds and moss. Place one largest rosette upper-left, one split ivory overgrown colony hull fragment upper-right, two mounds left/right of center, two near lower corners and one small upper-center. Clear collision footprints and open paths. Huge umbrella canopy fragments and alien foliage only at far edges, cropped overhead, do not obscure actors. No water channels that appear impassable; no arbitrary walls or resource collectables. High-quality painterly game art, soft lilac dawn lighting, teal shadow pools, fine biological textures but quiet ground. No pixel art, no photoreal 3D landscape.

UI: very restrained, leaving at least 88% of the image for play. Tiny top-left label 'GLASS TIDE / TOP-DOWN'. Top-center small pearl membrane capsule reads 'GEN 08 · 00:18'. Bottom-left separate soft-edged organic membrane, dark matte text backing, readable 'RUN 01:24.36'; below it a compact 5-lamella respiration organ labeled 'SPRINT'. Lower-right small leaf-vein minimap with square arena outline, four gate notches, one white player and a few amber enemy symbols. No huge decorative border spanning screen. UI remains screen-space and unrotated. No health bar, weapons, combat buttons, holograms, metallic menus, quest/inventory system, glowing grid or additional text. Bottom-right near edge subtle caption 'DESIGN MOCKUP'. Beautiful and convincing as a playable quiet biological arena, with immediate visual distinction between people, active organisms, harmless eggs and solid obstacles.

refinements.overhead: Edit this image into a STRICT ZENITHAL TOP VIEW, as if the camera is a satellite pointing exactly straight down. The supplied image is incorrectly OBLIQUE; fix the camera, not merely the label. This edit must look substantially different: we must see ONLY TOP SURFACES. Preserve the Glass Tide colors, same obstacle and actor ground-position layout, same UI text and relative HUD placement, south passage at bottom. All circular footprints on the ground must be PERFECT CIRCLES. No visible vertical side surfaces on obstacles, no visible upright walls, no visible torso/face/front of any character. Every human is a tiny ochre circular HOOD TOP between two shoulders and a flat dark mantle/backpack silhouette directly under it, with arms/feet only tiny protrusions. Every sentinel is a small flat teardrop/radial seed-pod TOP SILHOUETTE with an orange nucleus and dark chitin outline, roughly the same footprint as a human; no upright insect body seen from side. Colony ruin upper-right appears as a flat roof/rib footprint. Plants are rosette crowns seen straight from above. Do not show trunk sides, cliffs, building facades or horizon. Use the literal camera orientation of Hotline Miami or a vertical overhead botanical map, but keep this lush detailed Glass Tide painted artwork, no pixel art. Flat x/y 2D sprite layering, diffuse daylight, short soft contact shadows only. Take away the long sprawling UI roots so bottom HUD is separate compact organs and not a fence. Keep exactly 'GLASS TIDE / TOP-DOWN', 'GEN 08 · 00:18', 'RUN 01:24.36', 'SPRINT', 'SOUTH PASSAGE', 'DESIGN MOCKUP'. Keep minimap lower-right. The requested output is a screenshot-style mockup for an existing perpendicular 2D Canvas game, NOT another beautiful 3D perspective painting. No specimen panels.
refinements.tilted: Make a minimal edit to this image for the second camera comparison: change the top-left title to EXACTLY 'GLASS TIDE / TILTED'. Preserve the existing oblique elevated camera angle, world layout, humans, sentinels, lighting, color, timer values, south passage and minimap positions. This is intentionally the tilted 2.5D interpretation, showing some actor bodies and obstacle sides, and must not be labeled top-down. Also remove the oversized decorative organic tendrils extending horizontally across the bottom playfield: retain the compact timer/sprint organ at bottom-left and separate compact minimap at bottom-right, and expose the walkable ground between them. Reduce active sentinel body sizes to approximately human-sized for believable arena gameplay, keeping their distinctive translucent orange anatomy. Keep all other text unchanged and keep 'DESIGN MOCKUP'. No new assets, no concept panels or changes to game mechanics.

note: Initial image was too oblique and is not a final top-down deliverable. Final two images are illustrative camera mockups, not application captures.
